britain-lf2.label: Luftflotte 2 fighter Gruppen
britain-lf2.note: Together with eight separately listed headquarters, these 21 Gruppen account for 669 aircraft on strength and 533 serviceable. The return records deployment for use against Britain.

sicily-gruppen.label: German fighter Gruppen based on Sicily
sicily-gruppen.note: Four numbered Gruppen and two separate wing headquarters were based on the island. Together their six rows give 136 aircraft held and 55 serviceable. Five other Gruppen in the same return were in Sardinia or mainland Italy.

sicily-xii.label: US XII Air Support Command groups
sicily-xii.note: Five group-level commands appear in this part of the Allied return. The 111th Tactical Reconnaissance Squadron is listed separately.

france-jg26.label: The three Gruppen of JG 26
france-jg26.note: This is a roster for JG 26 alone. Other German fighter wings and other air arms operated in the same campaign.

stalingrad-ro.label: Romanian aviation at the Don Bend

berlin-raid-first.label: First German scramble against the Berlin raid

bagration-air-armies.label: Soviet front-line air armies
bagration-air-armies.note: The 6th Air Army supported the later-active left wing. Long-Range Aviation reported separately. Regiment-level coverage remains partial.

market-response.label: German formations prepared against the landings

berlin-va.label: Soviet air armies in the Berlin operation

bagration-soviet-cover.label: Soviet fighter divisions ordered to cover the Bobruisk pocket

bagration-soviet-day-regiments.label: Soviet regiments in the 27 June records

bagration-polish-regiments.label: Polish air regiments on the 1 July return
